quote: making myself a first dissenter in Asch
content: Replication check: the experiment referred to here replicates. Franzen & Mader (2023) reproduced Asch's rate of conformity on critical trials almost exactly, and a meta-analysis of Asch-paradigm line-judgment studies (Bond & Smith 1996) confirmed the effect while finding that it varies with culture and declined in the US over time. The qualification: most Asch subjects did not conform on most trials. The discomfort the essay describes was real, and it was usually overcome.
